legend.destructive: performs a destructive or irreversible action (delete, remote push/delete, vault replace, provider mutation)
legend.secret_bearing: a plaintext secret crosses the IPC boundary inbound or outbound, or is written to disk/clipboard
legend.reauth_required: yes | no | conditional | is_auth | creates_auth | backup_password
legend.backend_enforcement: core = master-password reauth verified inside the core fn (a direct invoke cannot bypass it); wrapper = reauth verified only in the Tauri command in main.rs (see NEW_FINDINGS RA-P2-1); backup_password = the backup password is the authorization; structural = protected by requiring an UnlockedVault (with_vault) but no per-call reauth; structural_unlock_gate = read/metadata command gated only by the unlocked vault
legend.test_status: covered:<suite> = a Rust test exercises the backend path; not_covered = no direct Rust coverage yet; not_covered_wrapper_reauth = reauth lives in the Tauri wrapper and is not reachable from a core-level test (follow-up)

caveat: A harness exists and covers the security-sensitive/destructive command set enumerated in the Phase 2 brief. This inventory does NOT claim all 137 commands are fully secured or fully tested: low-relevance read/metadata commands are gated only by the unlocked vault and are marked not_covered; three commands (backup_create, provider_admin_connect, provider_admin_test) enforce reauth in the Tauri wrapper rather than core and are recorded as follow-ups.
increment_09_note: Increment 09 (Tethra Mesh, 2026-10-29) appended the 15 mesh_* rows of apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/mesh_cmds.rs, and Increment 10 (2026-11-02) the 15 mesh_project*/mesh_usage_report/mesh_cap* rows of apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/mesh_project_cmds.rs, and Increment 11 (2026-11-03) the 6 mesh_share*/mesh_credential_* rows of apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/mesh_share_cmds.rs, so total_commands counts the rows listed here (137 + 15 + 15 + 6). The rest of this inventory is stale: main.rs registers commands added since Phase 2 that it does not list. It is not a full re-inventory. Mesh rows: reauth for mesh_invite_create, mesh_device_remove, mesh_leave and mesh_cap_enforce (both on and off, one cap or every cap) is verified inside the core method; mesh_node_set_settings needs the master password only when it widens the LAN surface (all interfaces, mDNS discovery, a non-loopback listen address), also enforced in core (UnlockedVault::mesh_node_settings_set), and refuses with mesh_reauth_required without it. secret_bearing: mesh_invite_create returns the one-time invite string (outbound bearer secret); mesh_join receives it (inbound); mesh_cap_enforce receives the master password only, which core verifies and never echoes. Increment 10 rows: none is destructive. mesh_project_merge is an LWW merged_into pointer (no data is deleted; core refuses when both projects have caps) and mesh_cap_lower is an LWW target that the owner can raise again; both are confirmed in the UI. mesh_projects_list, mesh_usage_report (publish=false) and mesh_caps_list (reconcile=false) are polled reads that write nothing; publish/reconcile=true are explicit writes. Suites: tauri_command_authz, mesh_usage, mesh_caps, mesh_membership (crates/core/tests); supervisor, desktop_flow, pairing, node, discover, doctor (crates/mesh/tests); mesh_cli is apps/cli/tests/mesh_cli.rs (the same core methods through the CLI), where the CLI's one-shot replicate and leave paths, which the desktop shares, are also tested. Increment 11 rows: mesh_credential_share, mesh_credential_reseal and mesh_credential_import reauthenticate inside the core method (UnlockedVault::mesh_credential_share / mesh_credential_reseal / mesh_credential_import) before any value or the sealing key is read; none returns a credential value or sealed bytes (secret_bearing false: only the master password crosses inbound, verified and never echoed; an import returns the masked model). mesh_credential_import is destructive only with replace=true, which replaces a same-named credential's value and keeps the old one as a version, like credential_replace_value. mesh_share_revoke and mesh_credential_revoke mint revoke tombstones (confirmed in the UI; they revoke nothing at a provider and delete nothing). mesh_shares_list(purge=false) is the polled read that writes nothing. Suites: tauri_command_authz and mesh_share (crates/core/tests), share_wire (crates/mesh/tests), mesh_cli.
